title: DataPulse MY dataset series registry
description: Curated registry of record for dataset series identity. Each key under `series` is a series_code; its `dataset_ids` list every dataset id that carries that series identity, so one series across several dataset ids is one entry rather than a duplicate. Identity is authored here, not inferred from the manifest.

schema_id.description: Stable identifier for the current schema of this series; the trailing _vN is the versioned half of the schema_id.

schema_version.description: Integer version of the current schema; must equal the _vN suffix of schema_id, and any schema_id change must increment it.

dataset_ids.description: Every dataset id in datapulse.json that carries this series identity.

previous_schema_ids.description: Superseded schema_ids, newest last or any order; each must encode a version strictly below schema_version.
